headline: 尼詠歐主演家暴新劇
context: 奧斯卡影后露琵塔尼詠歐（Lupita Nyong'o）在紐約 Greenwich House 劇院，主演劇作家瑪琳愛爾蘭（Marin Ireland）的作品《Pre-Existing Condition》，這部劇講述一名女性從伴侶施暴、分手後走出創傷的過程，全劇長 75 分鐘。這齣劇 2024 年首演時，就曾由塔提雅娜瑪斯蘭尼、艾迪法可等多位演員接力演出。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Greenwich House Theater, New York The Oscar-winning actor transfixes in Marin Ireland’s masterfully nuanced play about a woman reeling from a toxic relationship Paradoxically, the more stars step into the lead role in Pre-Existing Condition , the more the brilliance of Marin Ireland’s domestic abuse play takes center stage. Not that it ever suffered from a lack of acting talent – when it premiered in 2024, at New York’s tiny Connelly Theater Upstairs, it counted Tatiana Maslany , Edie Falco and Deirdre O’Connell among the actors who played its central character in quick succession, for only a few weeks each. And this return engagement, at the larger Greenwich House Theater across town, kicks off with Lupita Nyong’o , before making way for Phillipa Soo, Susannah Flood, Hari Nef, Falco again and Whitney White. It’s a straightforward conceit, perfectly calibrated for a 75-minute run time. A woman (whom the script refers to as A, currently played by Nyong’o) is dealing with the aftermath of a breakup triggered by her partner hitting her. When we meet her, someone (perhaps a lawyer, or a therapist) is laying out the reality of her situation: even with the deep pockets required to go to court, it’s been seven months since the incident, it happened across state lines and she never called the police. “You have to be ready for a fight,” she tells A. “Which, just from our short time with each other, I can already tell that you’re not.” Continue reading...

thread_text:
奧斯卡影后露琵塔尼詠歐（Lupita Nyong'o），在紐約 Greenwich House 劇院主演劇作家瑪琳愛爾蘭（Marin Ireland）的作品《Pre-Existing Condition》。這部 75 分鐘的獨角戲，講述一名女性在伴侶動手打她之後，走出這段關係與創傷的過程。這齣劇 2024 年首演時，就曾由塔提雅娜瑪斯蘭尼、艾迪法可等多位演員接力演出；這次重新上演，接在尼詠歐之後，還會換上菲莉帕蘇、蘇珊娜弗勒德等好幾位演員輪流擔綱。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 15 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
奧斯卡影后露琵塔尼詠歐（Lupita Nyong'o），最近在紐約 Greenwich House 劇院，主演了劇作家瑪琳愛爾蘭（Marin Ireland）的作品《Pre-Existing Condition》。劇情圍繞著一位化名『A』的女性展開，她的伴侶動手打了她，這齣戲講的就是她走出這段關係、面對創傷的過程，全長 75 分鐘。這齣劇其實 2024 年就在紐約較小的 Connelly Theater Upstairs 首演過，當時由塔提雅娜瑪斯蘭尼、艾迪法可、黛爾德麗歐康乃爾等多位演員，各自輪流演出短短幾週。這次移師到規模更大的 Greenwich House 劇院重新上演，尼詠歐打頭陣，接下來還會有菲莉帕蘇、蘇珊娜弗勒德、哈里內夫、法可再度回歸，以及惠特妮懷特輪番接棒。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 15 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 奧斯卡影后露琵塔尼詠歐，最近在紐約演了一齣舞台劇。劇名是《Pre-Existing Condition》，講一位女性在伴侶動手打她之後，怎麼走出這段關係、面對創傷，全長七十五分鐘。這齣劇其實不是第一次上演，二零二四年就在紐約一間小劇場首演過，當時好幾位演員輪流接手這個角色。這次移師到規模更大的劇院重新上演，尼詠歐打頭陣，之後還會有好幾位演員接棒演出。
